descriptionEn: A square wave can be decomposed into odd sine harmonics. Their amplitudes are \(\frac{4}{\pi n}\): higher frequencies contribute less. Adding the seven terms shown approximates the square wave.
descriptionZh: 方波可以分解为奇次正弦谐波，各项振幅为 \(\frac{4}{\pi n}\)，频率越高，振幅越小。将图中的七项相加，就得到方波的近似。
readingEn: Vector \(n\) rotates at angular speed \(n\), with length \(\frac{4}{\pi n}\). Connecting the vectors adds their vertical projections: the tip traces the wave, and the bars show amplitudes.
readingZh: 第 \(n\) 根向量以角速度 \(n\) 旋转，长度为 \(\frac{4}{\pi n}\)。首尾相接后，末端高度就是各竖直投影之和，描出波形；柱形高度表示振幅。

descriptionEn: The point combines perpendicular oscillations with a \(3:2\) frequency ratio. After three horizontal cycles and two vertical cycles, both phases return together, closing the curve.
descriptionZh: 光点合成了频率比为 \(3:2\) 的两个垂直振动。横向完成三个周期、纵向完成两个周期后，两者同时回到原相位，轨迹因此闭合。
readingEn: The horizontal coordinate follows \(\sin(3t)\); the vertical coordinate follows \(\cos(2t)\). The bright trail shows recent positions along the same fixed curve.
readingZh: 横坐标按 \(\sin(3t)\) 变化，纵坐标按 \(\cos(2t)\) 变化。亮色尾迹标出最近经过的位置，整条曲线本身保持不变。

source.zh: 曼彻斯特大学 · 膜的振型

descriptionEn: For a square membrane with fixed edges, \(\sin(2x)\sin(3y)\) sets the mode shape and the cosine factor reverses its displacement in time. Wherever a sine factor is zero, the membrane stays still.
descriptionZh: 对于边缘固定的方形膜，\(\sin(2x)\sin(3y)\) 决定振型，余弦因子控制位移随时间正负交替。任一正弦因子为零的位置，始终保持静止。
readingEn: The gold line marks \(x=\pi/2\); the cyan lines mark \(y=\pi/3\) and \(2\pi/3\). These nodal lines separate six regions that oscillate with alternating signs.
readingZh: 金线标出 \(x=\pi/2\)，青线标出 \(y=\pi/3\) 和 \(2\pi/3\)。这些节线分出六个区域，相邻区域的位移符号相反。

descriptionEn: A concentrated pulse diffuses into a Gaussian. Its width grows as \(\sqrt{t}\) and its peak falls as \(1/t\); in two dimensions these changes preserve the total integral over the plane.
descriptionZh: 集中的脉冲扩散为高斯分布：宽度按 \(\sqrt{t}\) 增大，峰值按 \(1/t\) 降低。在二维平面上，两者恰好使整个分布的积分保持不变。
readingEn: The mesh shows this density spreading with time. The plot is a finite window into an unbounded plane; each animation cycle restarts the same diffusion process.
readingZh: 网格显示密度如何随时间摊开。画面只是无限平面的一块有限窗口；每轮动画重新演示同一次扩散过程。

descriptionEn: For \(z=x^2-y^2\), the gradient is zero at the origin. Along \(x\) the height increases, but along \(y\) it decreases, so the origin is neither a local minimum nor a local maximum.
descriptionZh: 对 \(z=x^2-y^2\)，原点的梯度为零；但沿 \(x\) 方向高度增大，沿 \(y\) 方向高度减小，因此原点既不是局部极小值，也不是局部极大值。
readingEn: The gold section is \(z=x^2\); the cyan section is \(z=-y^2\). Moving points compare these two directions on the same stationary surface.
readingZh: 金色截线对应 \(z=x^2\)，青色截线对应 \(z=-y^2\)。两个光点沿截线移动，对照同一个静止曲面上的升降方向。

descriptionEn: A half-twist joins one edge of a strip to the opposite edge. This identification creates a nonorientable surface: the two apparent sides belong to one continuous side.
descriptionZh: 纸带扭转半周再首尾相接，一端的一侧便接到另一端的对侧。这种连接形成不可定向曲面，看似两面，实际是连续的同一面。
readingEn: The gold point follows the boundary. After one turn it reaches the opposite edge of the original strip; after two turns it returns, revealing a single connected boundary.
readingZh: 金色光点沿边界移动：绕一周到达原纸带的另一条边，再绕一周才回到起点，显出两条边已连成一条完整边界。

descriptionEn: Successive points turn by the golden angle, about \(137.5^\circ\). This irrational fraction of a full turn avoids repeated radial alignments; \(r=\sqrt{n}\) makes the area enclosed grow linearly with point count.
descriptionZh: 相邻点转过约 \(137.5^\circ\) 的黄金角。它占整周的比例是无理数，因此不会周期性地落在同一射线上；\(r=\sqrt{n}\) 使圆内面积随点数线性增长。
readingEn: The bright points appear in placement order. Two families of visible spirals emerge from this one angle-and-radius rule, a common model of sunflower seed arrangements.
readingZh: 亮点按放置顺序出现。仅凭这一组转角与半径规则，就会浮现两组旋向相反的螺旋，这是向日葵种子排列的一种常用模型。

descriptionEn: A complex exponential of unit magnitude traces the unit circle. Its real and imaginary parts are the horizontal and vertical projections, so multiplication by \(e^{i\theta}\) represents a rotation.
descriptionZh: 模长为一的复指数沿单位圆运动。实部和虚部分别是水平、竖直投影，因此乘以 \(e^{i\theta}\) 对应一次旋转。
readingEn: The rotating radius and its projections share one angle. The curve on the right records the imaginary part, \(\sin\theta\), as that angle increases.
readingZh: 旋转半径与两个投影共用同一个角度。右侧曲线记录角度增大时的虚部 \(\sin\theta\)。

descriptionEn: Matching derivatives at zero produces a polynomial approximation to \(\sin x\). Every additional odd-power term captures another derivative; for any fixed finite interval, the sequence converges to the sine curve.
descriptionZh: 在零点匹配各阶导数，可以构造 \(\sin x\) 的多项式近似。每增加一个奇次幂项，就匹配更高阶导数；在任意固定的有限区间上，这组近似收敛到正弦曲线。
readingEn: The cyan curve is \(\sin x\). The green polynomial uses one through five terms in turn: agreement appears first near zero and extends outward.
readingZh: 青色曲线是 \(\sin x\)，绿色多项式依次使用一至五项。近似先在零点附近吻合，再逐渐向两侧延伸。

descriptionEn: Two nearby frequencies alternate between reinforcement and cancellation. Their sum has a rapidly oscillating carrier and a slowly varying amplitude; successive loudness peaks are separated by the reciprocal of the frequency difference.
descriptionZh: 两个相近频率的振动交替相长、相消。叠加结果包含快速振荡的载波和缓慢变化的振幅；相邻响度峰值的时间间隔是两者频率差的倒数。
readingEn: The green trace adds angular frequencies 10 and 11. The gold boundaries show \(\pm2|\cos(t/2)|\); the amplitude vanishes where those boundaries meet.
readingZh: 绿色曲线叠加角频率为 10 和 11 的振动。金色边界为 \(\pm2|\cos(t/2)|\)，边界相遇时振幅降为零。

descriptionEn: Near a jump, a truncated Fourier series overshoots. Increasing the term count narrows the ringing region, but the limiting overshoot remains about 9% of the jump height. Pointwise convergence away from the jump does not imply uniform convergence.
descriptionZh: 在跳跃间断点附近，截断的傅里叶级数会出现过冲。增加项数使振铃区域收窄，但极限过冲仍约为跳跃高度的 9%。远离间断点的逐点收敛，并不意味着一致收敛。
readingEn: Three, eleven, and thirty-one terms are shown successively against a square wave. Watch the peaks beside zero rather than just the flatter sections.
readingZh: 图中依次使用三项、十一项和三十一项，并以方波作参照。注意零点两侧的峰值，而不只是逐渐变平的区段。

descriptionEn: Convolution multiplies one function by a reflected, shifted copy of the other and integrates the product. For two unit boxes, that integral equals their overlap length, producing a triangular function.
descriptionZh: 卷积将一个函数与另一个函数翻转、平移后的副本相乘，再对乘积积分。两个单位矩形的卷积就是它们的重叠长度，因此得到三角形函数。
readingEn: The fixed interval is \([0,1]\); the moving interval is \([t-1,t]\). Their highlighted intersection grows and shrinks, while the lower point records its length.
readingZh: 固定区间为 \([0,1]\)，移动区间为 \([t-1,t]\)。高亮交集先增大再缩小，下方光点记录它的长度。

source.zh: MathWorld · 高斯函数的时频宽度

descriptionEn: Under the transform convention \(\widehat f(\omega)=\int f(x)e^{-i\omega x}\,dx\), a Gaussian \(f(x)=e^{-x^2/(2\sigma^2)}\) stays Gaussian. Its spatial width is proportional to \(\sigma\), while its frequency width is proportional to \(1/\sigma\).
descriptionZh: 采用变换约定 \(\widehat f(\omega)=\int f(x)e^{-i\omega x}\,dx\) 时，高斯函数 \(f(x)=e^{-x^2/(2\sigma^2)}\) 的变换仍是高斯函数。空间宽度正比于 \(\sigma\)，频率宽度则正比于 \(1/\sigma\)。
readingEn: Green shows the spatial profile and gold the frequency profile, with both peaks normalized to one to compare widths. A wider profile on one side means a narrower profile on the other.
readingZh: 绿色表示空间分布，金色表示频率分布；两者峰值均归一化为一，以便比较宽度。一侧变宽，另一侧就变窄。

descriptionEn: Sampling at 6 Hz cannot distinguish these 1 Hz and 7 Hz sinusoids: they differ by a whole cycle between adjacent samples. Without a suitable band limit before sampling, distinct continuous signals can produce identical sample sequences.
descriptionZh: 以 6 Hz 采样时，图中的 1 Hz 与 7 Hz 正弦波无法区分：它们在相邻采样点之间相差一个完整周期。采样前若没有适当的带限，不同连续信号就可能得到完全相同的样本序列。
readingEn: The slowly varying green wave and rapidly varying cyan wave meet at every gold sample. The moving marker visits times \(n/6\), not the unobserved points between them.
readingZh: 缓慢变化的绿色波与快速变化的青色波经过每一个金色采样点。移动标记依次经过 \(n/6\) 时刻，不经过样本之间未观测的位置。

descriptionEn: A cubic Bézier curve is built from four control points. Repeated linear interpolation with the same parameter produces a point on the curve; the endpoint tangents follow the first and last edges of the control polygon.
descriptionZh: 三次贝塞尔曲线由四个控制点确定。使用同一参数反复做线性插值，就得到曲线上的点；两端切线分别沿控制多边形的首边和末边。
readingEn: Gold segments join first-stage interpolation points; the cyan segment joins the next pair. Its moving green point traces the final curve as \(t\) runs from zero to one.
readingZh: 金色线段连接第一轮插值点，青色线段连接下一轮的两个点。其上的绿色光点在 \(t\) 从零走到一时描出曲线。

descriptionEn: A point on the rim of a unit circle rolling without slipping traces a cycloid. The center translates by the same distance as the rim unwinds, combining uniform translation with circular motion.
descriptionZh: 单位圆无滑动滚动时，圆周上一点描出摆线。圆心的平移距离等于圆周展开的弧长，因而轨迹由匀速平移与圆周运动叠加而成。
readingEn: The gold radius tracks the marked rim point. At each ground contact, translation and rotation cancel its instantaneous velocity, forming a cusp.
readingZh: 金色半径跟随圆周上的标记点。每次接触地面时，平移与旋转带来的瞬时速度相消，轨迹形成尖点。

descriptionEn: For a logarithmic spiral, rotating through a fixed angle multiplies the radius by a fixed factor. The angle between the tangent and radius stays constant, expressing the same self-similarity at every scale.
descriptionZh: 对数螺线每转过一个固定角度，半径就乘以同一个比例因子。切线与半径的夹角保持不变，因此不同尺度下保留相同的形态。
readingEn: The point moves outward on \(r=0.1e^{0.2\theta}\). The highlighted radius grows exponentially; each full turn multiplies its length by \(e^{0.4\pi}\).
readingZh: 光点沿 \(r=0.1e^{0.2\theta}\) 向外移动，高亮半径按指数增长。每转一整圈，长度就乘以 \(e^{0.4\pi}\)。

descriptionEn: An ellipse consists of points whose distances to two fixed foci have a constant sum. For semiaxes \(a>b\), the foci lie at distance \(\sqrt{a^2-b^2}\) from the center along the major axis.
descriptionZh: 椭圆上任一点到两个固定焦点的距离之和保持不变。设半轴为 \(a>b\)，焦点位于长轴上，距中心 \(\sqrt{a^2-b^2}\)。
readingEn: As the point travels around the ellipse, the green and gold focal segments exchange length. The stacked bar below keeps the same total length, \(2a\).
readingZh: 光点沿椭圆运动时，绿色与金色焦距线段此消彼长。下方叠加条的总长度始终为 \(2a\)。

descriptionEn: Unwinding a taut string from a unit circle makes its free end trace an involute. The straight portion remains tangent to the circle, and its length equals the arc length already unwound.
descriptionZh: 将绷紧的细线从单位圆上逐渐展开，自由端就描出渐开线。展开后的直线段始终与圆相切，其长度等于已经展开的圆弧长度。
readingEn: The gold point is the tangency point, and the green point is the free end. The tangent segment length increases as \(t\), even though the circle radius stays one.
readingZh: 金色点是切点，绿色点是自由端。圆的半径始终为一，而切线段长度随 \(t\) 增加。

descriptionEn: A linear map sends a unit square to the parallelogram spanned by its column vectors. The determinant measures oriented area: its magnitude is the area scale and its sign records whether orientation is reversed.
descriptionZh: 线性映射将单位正方形变为由矩阵列向量张成的平行四边形。行列式度量有向面积：绝对值是面积缩放倍数，符号表示方向是否翻转。
readingEn: The grid deforms continuously from the identity to \(A=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1.3&0.6\\0.4&1.1\end{smallmatrix}\right)\). At the endpoint, the highlighted square has area 1.19.
readingZh: 网格从恒等变换连续形变到 \(A=\left(\begin{smallmatrix}1.3&0.6\\0.4&1.1\end{smallmatrix}\right)\)。在终点，高亮正方形的像面积为 1.19。

descriptionEn: An eigenvector keeps its line of direction under a linear transformation. For this symmetric matrix, the directions \((1,1)\) and \((1,-1)\) are perpendicular, with scale factors three and one.
descriptionZh: 特征向量在线性变换后仍处于原来的直线上。对于这个对称矩阵，\((1,1)\) 与 \((1,-1)\) 两个方向相互垂直，对应伸缩倍数分别为三和一。
readingEn: Gray spokes show the original unit circle. Green vectors along one diagonal stretch threefold; gold vectors along the other remain unchanged while intermediate directions turn.
readingZh: 灰色辐条标出原单位圆。一条对角线上的绿色向量伸长为三倍，另一条上的金色向量保持不变，其间的一般方向则发生转动。

descriptionEn: A real matrix factors into orthogonal transformations and independent axis scalings. A unit circle becomes an ellipse whose semiaxis lengths are the singular values; its principal directions are the left singular vectors.
descriptionZh: 实矩阵可以分解为正交变换与各坐标轴上的独立缩放。单位圆由此变为椭圆，半轴长度是奇异值，主轴方向是左奇异向量。
readingEn: The marked circle first rotates by \(V^{\mathsf T}\), stretches by factors 2 and 0.6, then rotates by \(U\). The moving seam makes the otherwise invisible first rotation visible.
readingZh: 带标记的圆先经 \(V^{\mathsf T}\) 旋转，再按 2 和 0.6 缩放，最后经 \(U\) 旋转。移动的标记线使圆轮廓上不易察觉的第一步旋转可见。

descriptionEn: For \(f(x,y)=(x^2+4y^2)/2\), the gradient is normal to elliptical level sets. With step size 0.2, each update multiplies the horizontal coordinate by 0.8 and the vertical coordinate by 0.2, approaching the minimum.
descriptionZh: 对于 \(f(x,y)=(x^2+4y^2)/2\)，梯度垂直于椭圆形等高线。步长取 0.2 时，每次更新将横坐标乘以 0.8、纵坐标乘以 0.2，逐渐接近最小值点。
readingEn: The dots are actual iterates from \((2.6,1.5)\). Their curved path reflects unequal curvature along the two axes; connecting segments indicate updates, not a continuous physical trajectory.
readingZh: 光点是从 \((2.6,1.5)\) 出发的真实迭代点。路径弯曲源于两个方向的曲率不同；连接线表示离散更新，不是连续的物理运动轨迹。

descriptionEn: Newton’s method replaces a curve locally by its tangent and takes that tangent’s root as the next estimate. For \(f(x)=x^2-2\), this gives \(x_{k+1}=(x_k+2/x_k)/2\), converging rapidly from the positive start shown.
descriptionZh: 牛顿法在局部用切线代替曲线，将切线的零点作为下一次估计。对 \(f(x)=x^2-2\)，更新为 \(x_{k+1}=(x_k+2/x_k)/2\)，从图中的正初值出发会快速收敛。
readingEn: The gold tangent starts at each green point on the parabola. Its intersection with the horizontal axis becomes the next input; the iterations approach \(\sqrt2\).
readingZh: 金色切线经过抛物线上的绿色点，与横轴的交点成为下一次输入。各次迭代逐渐接近 \(\sqrt2\)。

descriptionEn: If a continuous function has opposite signs at two endpoints, a root lies between them. Testing the midpoint and retaining the sign-changing half shrinks the bracket predictably, without using derivatives.
descriptionZh: 连续函数在两个端点异号时，区间内至少存在一个零点。检查中点并保留两端异号的一半区间，就能以确定的速度缩小范围，无需计算导数。
readingEn: The bracket begins at \([1,2]\) for \(f(x)=x^3-x-2\). Gold marks each midpoint; the shaded strip retains the half that still contains a sign change.
readingZh: 图中对 \(f(x)=x^3-x-2\) 从 \([1,2]\) 开始搜索。金色点标记中点，阴影保留仍含符号变化的半区间。

descriptionEn: An integral is the limit of weighted samples as the partition becomes fine. On \([0,1]\), the decreasing function \(1/(1+x^2)\) makes left-endpoint rectangles overestimate the area; the excess tends to zero.
descriptionZh: 积分是分割不断加细时加权采样和的极限。在 \([0,1]\) 上，\(1/(1+x^2)\) 单调递减，因此左端点矩形高估曲线下的面积；多出的面积趋于零。
readingEn: The green rectangles use 4, 8, 16, and 32 intervals. Their top-left corners meet the gold curve, whose exact enclosed area is \(\pi/4\).
readingZh: 绿色矩形依次使用 4、8、16 和 32 个区间，左上角落在金色曲线上。曲线下的准确面积为 \(\pi/4\)。

descriptionEn: Divergence measures local net outflow. For the radial field \(F=(x,y)\), the outward flux through a radius-\(r\) circle equals its area times the constant divergence, two.
descriptionZh: 散度度量局部净流出量。径向场 \(F=(x,y)\) 穿过半径为 \(r\) 的圆周的向外通量，等于圆面积乘以恒定散度二。
readingEn: Particles separate as they follow the radial field. The gold circle is a fixed boundary: outward velocity there has magnitude \(r\), so integrating around its circumference gives \(2\pi r^2\).
readingZh: 粒子沿径向场运动时彼此远离。金色圆是固定边界，其上向外速度大小为 \(r\)，沿圆周积分即得 \(2\pi r^2\)。

descriptionEn: For \(F=(-y,x)\), particles rotate counterclockwise without radial expansion. The out-of-plane curl is two, and its area integral equals the counterclockwise circulation around the boundary.
descriptionZh: 对于 \(F=(-y,x)\)，粒子逆时针旋转而不沿径向扩张。垂直平面方向的旋度为二，其面积分等于沿边界逆时针方向的环流。
readingEn: All particles have the same angular speed; outer particles move faster along larger circles. No particle crosses the gold circle, so flux is zero even though circulation is nonzero.
readingZh: 所有粒子角速度相同，外侧粒子沿更大的圆以更高线速度运动。没有粒子穿过金色圆，因此通量为零，但环流并不为零。

descriptionEn: Independent unit steps with uniformly random directions have zero mean. Cross terms cancel in the expected squared displacement, leaving one contribution per step; typical distance grows like the square root of elapsed steps.
descriptionZh: 方向均匀随机的独立单位步长，均值为零。位移平方的期望中交叉项相消，每一步贡献一项，因此典型距离按步数的平方根增长。
readingEn: Eight fixed sample paths unfold together. The gold circle has radius \(\sqrt n\), an ensemble root-mean-square scale, not a boundary that confines individual walks.
readingZh: 八条固定样本轨迹一起展开。金色圆半径为 \(\sqrt n\)，表示总体均方根尺度，并非限制每条轨迹的边界。

descriptionEn: For independent uniform variables on \([0,1]\), subtracting the sum’s mean and dividing by its standard deviation puts every sum on the same scale. As the count grows, the standardized distribution approaches a normal distribution.
descriptionZh: 对相互独立的 \([0,1]\) 均匀随机变量，将和减去均值、再除以标准差，就能放在同一尺度上比较。项数增加时，标准化后的分布趋近于正态分布。
readingEn: Green shows the exact standardized density for one through eight summands, not a sampled histogram. The gold curve is the standard normal density.
readingZh: 绿色展示一至八项求和后标准化的准确密度，而非抽样直方图。金色曲线是标准正态密度。

descriptionEn: When independent Bernoulli trials become numerous and their success probability decreases with \(np=\lambda\) fixed, the count of successes approaches a Poisson distribution. The mean count stays fixed while individual events become rare.
descriptionZh: 当独立伯努利试验次数增加、成功概率减小，并保持 \(np=\lambda\) 不变时，成功次数趋近于泊松分布。平均次数保持不变，而单次事件越来越罕见。
readingEn: Green bars show \(\operatorname{Bin}(n,3/n)\) for increasing \(n\); gold dots mark \(\operatorname{Poisson}(3)\). Horizontal positions are integer event counts, not continuous measurements.
readingZh: 绿色柱表示 \(n\) 逐渐增大时的 \(\operatorname{Bin}(n,3/n)\)，金色点表示 \(\operatorname{Poisson}(3)\)。横向位置是整数事件次数，不是连续测量值。

descriptionEn: A uniform prior for a Bernoulli success probability is a Beta(1,1) distribution. After observing \(h\) successes and \(t\) failures, multiplying by the likelihood yields Beta(1+h,1+t), describing uncertainty about that same probability.
descriptionZh: 伯努利成功概率的均匀先验是 Beta(1,1) 分布。观察到 \(h\) 次成功和 \(t\) 次失败后，将先验乘以似然，得到 Beta(1+h,1+t)，描述对同一概率的不确定性。
readingEn: The gold line is the initial prior. The green posterior changes as the fixed sequence 1,1,0,1,0,1,1,1 arrives; green observation dots indicate successes and cyan dots failures.
readingZh: 金色线是初始先验。固定序列 1、1、0、1、0、1、1、1 依次出现时，绿色后验随之更新；绿色观测点表示成功，青色点表示失败。

descriptionEn: For a right triangle with legs \(a,b\) and hypotenuse \(c\), the squares on the two legs have the same combined area as the square on the hypotenuse. The right angle is essential; arbitrary triangles do not obey this identity.
descriptionZh: 直角三角形的两条直角边为 \(a,b\)，斜边为 \(c\)。以两条直角边为边长的正方形，面积之和等于斜边上正方形的面积。直角是必要条件，一般三角形不满足这个等式。
readingEn: The green and cyan squares sit on the legs; the gold square sits on the hypotenuse. The legs change while the angle stays right. Below, the green and cyan area bars together always match the gold bar at the same scale.
readingZh: 绿色和青色正方形分别对应两条直角边，金色正方形对应斜边。边长变化时，夹角始终保持直角。下方使用同一比例尺：绿色与青色面积条拼接后的长度，始终等于金色面积条。

descriptionEn: With positive growth rate \(r\) and capacity \(K\), the logistic model reduces per-capita growth as the population rises. Starting from \(0<N_0<K\), the population approaches \(K\). Its absolute growth rate peaks at \(N=K/2\), then slows; this is a continuous differential equation, not the discrete logistic map.
descriptionZh: 在增长率 \(r>0\)、容量 \(K>0\) 的 Logistic 模型中，数量越多，每个个体的增长贡献越小。从 \(0<N_0<K\) 出发，总量逐渐接近 \(K\)。总量的增长速度在 \(N=K/2\) 时最大，此后减慢；这里讨论连续微分方程，不是离散的 Logistic 映射。
readingEn: The green curve uses \(r=K=1\) and \(N_0=0.08\). Gold marks the capacity, while the moving cyan tangent shows the instantaneous growth rate. The tangent steepens near half capacity and flattens as the curve approaches the upper line.
readingZh: 绿色曲线取 \(r=K=1\)、\(N_0=0.08\)。金线标出容量，移动的青色切线表示瞬时增长速度。接近容量一半时，切线最陡；越接近上方金线，切线越平。

descriptionEn: The \(n\) complex solutions of \(z^n=1\) lie on the unit circle, separated by an angle of \(2\pi/n\). Multiplication by \(e^{2\pi i/n}\) advances from one root to the next; after \(n\) steps it returns to the starting point.
descriptionZh: 方程 \(z^n=1\) 的 \(n\) 个复数解都在单位圆上，相邻两根的夹角为 \(2\pi/n\)。乘以 \(e^{2\pi i/n}\) 就转到下一个根，连续进行 \(n\) 次后回到起点。
readingEn: The diagram uses seven roots. Cyan vertices form a regular heptagon; the green radius highlights successive roots, starting with the gold radius at \(1\). The short gold arc marks the angle between neighbors. Every highlighted vertex still has seventh power \(1\).
readingZh: 图中取七个单位根。青色顶点构成正七边形，绿色半径依次指向各个根；起点 \(1\) 由金色半径标出，短金弧表示相邻两根的夹角。无论点亮哪个顶点，它的七次方都等于 \(1\)。

en: A Markov chain forgets its start
zh: 马尔可夫链怎样趋于稳态
descriptionEn: Let \(a\) be the probability of moving from state 0 to 1, and \(b\) the reverse probability. The probability \(p_n\) of occupying state 0 follows \(p_{n+1}=b+(1-a-b)p_n\). For \(0<a,b<1\), its distance from equilibrium contracts because \(|1-a-b|<1\); the limiting distribution does not depend on the initial state.
descriptionZh: 设从状态 0 转到状态 1 的概率为 \(a\)，反向转移的概率为 \(b\)。处于状态 0 的概率 \(p_n\) 满足 \(p_{n+1}=b+(1-a-b)p_n\)。当 \(0<a,b<1\) 时，\(|1-a-b|<1\)，它与稳态概率的差距逐步缩小，极限分布不依赖初始状态。
readingEn: With \(a=0.2\) and \(b=0.3\), green starts at probability one and cyan at zero. Both approach the gold line at \(\pi_0=0.6\). Dots mark integer steps; connecting segments guide the eye and do not add intermediate transitions.
readingZh: 图中取 \(a=0.2\)、\(b=0.3\)。绿色从概率一出发，青色从零出发，最后都接近金线 \(\pi_0=0.6\)。光点表示整数步，连接线仅帮助观察走势，不表示步与步之间还有额外转移。

source.zh: Pishro-Nik 概率教材 · 平稳分布与极限分布
佐治亚理工学院 · 正交投影

descriptionEn: For a nonzero direction \(u\), the projection \(p\) of \(v\) onto its line is the closest vector on that line. Choosing the multiple of \(u\) so that the residual \(v-p\) is perpendicular to \(u\) determines \(p\) uniquely.
descriptionZh: 给定非零方向向量 \(u\)，向量 \(v\) 在这条直线上的正交投影 \(p\)，是直线上距离 \(v\) 最近的向量。令 \(p\) 为 \(u\) 的倍数，再要求残差 \(v-p\) 与 \(u\) 垂直，就能唯一确定 \(p\)。
readingEn: The cyan vector moves while the line stays fixed. Its green projection slides along the line; the gold residual connects the projection to the cyan tip. The small right-angle marker follows the projection, showing why this distance is the shortest.
readingZh: 青色向量不断转动，投影直线保持不变。绿色投影沿直线移动，金色残差从投影端点连到青色端点。小直角标记始终跟着投影移动，表明这段距离为什么最短。

zh: 二元熵为什么最多是一比特
descriptionEn: For two outcomes with probabilities \(p\) and \(1-p\), Shannon entropy measures average uncertainty in bits. We use the continuous endpoint convention \(0\log_2 0=0\). Entropy is zero for a certain outcome and reaches one bit at \(p=1/2\), where neither outcome is more predictable than the other.
descriptionZh: 当两个结果的概率分别为 \(p\) 和 \(1-p\) 时，香农熵以比特度量平均不确定性。端点按连续极限定义为 \(0\log_2 0=0\)。结果确定时熵为零；在 \(p=1/2\) 时达到一比特，因为两个结果都没有更高的可预测性。
readingEn: The lower strip divides a total probability of one into green \(p\) and cyan \(1-p\). The moving gold point reads the entropy on the upper curve. Equal-length segments correspond to the maximum; moving toward either certain outcome lowers entropy.
readingZh: 下方长条将总概率一分为绿色的 \(p\) 和青色的 \(1-p\)。移动的金色点在上方曲线上标出对应熵值。两段等长时熵最大；无论向哪一侧的确定结果靠近，熵都会下降。

descriptionEn: For real vectors, the magnitude of the dot product cannot exceed the product of their lengths. For nonzero vectors, the ratio is \(|\cos\theta|\), where \(\theta\) is their angle. Equality holds when their directions are parallel or opposite; a zero vector also gives equality.
descriptionZh: 实向量点积的绝对值，不会超过两向量长度的乘积。对于非零向量，两者之比等于夹角的 \(|\cos\theta|\)。两个方向相同或相反时取等号；任一向量为零时也取等号。
readingEn: The gold vector stays horizontal and the green vector rotates with fixed length. On the right, the green bar shows the absolute dot product and the gold bar shows the fixed product of lengths. They meet only when the two vectors line up.
readingZh: 金色向量保持水平，绿色向量在长度不变的情况下转动。右侧绿条表示点积的绝对值，金条表示固定的长度乘积。只有两个向量处于同一直线方向时，两条才一样长。

descriptionEn: An exponential waiting time has survival probability \(S(t)=e^{-\lambda t}\), with constant rate \(\lambda>0\). Conditioning on already having waited \(s\) divides the tail by \(S(s)\), leaving the same distribution for the additional wait \(u\). This follows from the exponential model; it is not a rule for every real queue or device lifetime.
descriptionZh: 指数等待时间的生存概率为 \(S(t)=e^{-\lambda t}\)，其中速率 \(\lambda>0\) 恒定。已等待 \(s\) 而事件尚未发生时，把剩余尾部除以 \(S(s)\)，得到的额外等待时间 \(u\) 仍服从原分布。这是指数模型的性质，不是所有现实队列或设备寿命都满足的规律。
readingEn: The upper curve uses \(\lambda=0.7\) and marks elapsed times \(s\) and \(s+2\). Their survival-probability ratio stays near 0.247 as \(s\) moves. Below, the normalized green tail overlaps the gold original survival curve when both are plotted against additional waiting time \(u\).
readingZh: 上图取 \(\lambda=0.7\)，标出已等待时间 \(s\) 与 \(s+2\)。随着 \(s\) 移动，两处生存概率的比值始终约为 0.247。下图改用额外等待时间 \(u\) 为横轴，归一化后的绿色尾部与金色的原生存曲线重合。

source.zh: Pishro-Nik 概率教材 · 指数分布

en: The remainder of a geometric series
descriptionEn: When \(|r|<1\), the series beginning with \(1\) sums to \(1/(1-r)\). Keeping only the first \(n\) terms leaves the exact remainder \(R_n=r^n/(1-r)\). Each extra term multiplies the remainder by \(r\), so its magnitude contracts geometrically.
descriptionZh: 当 \(|r|<1\) 时，从 \(1\) 开始的几何级数总和为 \(1/(1-r)\)。只保留前 \(n\) 项，剩余部分恰好是 \(R_n=r^n/(1-r)\)。每多取一项，余项就乘以 \(r\)，因此余项的绝对值按固定比例缩小。
readingEn: With \(r=1/2\), the full strip represents a sum of \(2\). Green blocks show retained terms and the gold block shows everything still missing. Each cycle adds one through seven terms, halving the gold remainder at each step; the displayed decimals are rounded.
readingZh: 图中取 \(r=1/2\)，整条矩形代表总和 \(2\)。绿色分块表示已保留的各项，金色部分表示尚未加入的余项。每轮从一项增加到七项，每增加一项，金色余项就减半；显示的小数经过四舍五入。

descriptionEn: For a convex function, averaging inputs before applying the function cannot exceed averaging the transformed inputs, provided the expectations exist. Geometrically, each chord lies above the graph. For \(f(x)=x^2\), the difference is variance: spread in the inputs raises the average squared value.
descriptionZh: 对于凸函数，在相关期望存在时，先对输入求平均、再代入函数，结果不会超过先计算函数值、再求平均。几何上，这对应曲线上的弦位于图像上方。取 \(f(x)=x^2\) 时，两种计算结果之差就是方差：输入越分散，平方值的平均就越大。
readingEn: The green parabola is \(x^2\); the gold chord joins inputs \(a=-2\) and \(b=1.5\). A weight \(w\) moves the mean \((1-w)a+wb\). The cyan segment measures the gap \(w(1-w)(a-b)^2\), which vanishes when all weight is placed on either endpoint.
readingZh: 绿色抛物线表示 \(x^2\)，金色弦连接输入 \(a=-2\) 与 \(b=1.5\)。权重 \(w\) 改变时，均值 \((1-w)a+wb\) 随之移动。青色线段表示差值 \(w(1-w)(a-b)^2\)；全部权重落在任一端点时，这个差值为零。

descriptionEn: Inversion in a circle of radius \(R\) sends a point \(P\ne O\) along the same ray to \(P'\), with \(OP\,OP'=R^2\). Points inside and outside exchange places; points on the circle stay fixed. Applying the map twice recovers the original point.
descriptionZh: 半径为 \(R\) 的圆反演，把圆心以外的点 \(P\) 沿同一射线映到 \(P'\)，并满足 \(OP\,OP'=R^2\)。圆内、圆外的点互相交换，圆周上的点保持不动。连续反演两次，就会回到原来的点。
readingEn: The cyan circle is fixed, with its center as the origin. Green \(P\) moves radially and around the center; gold \(P'\) stays on the same ray. When one approaches the center, the other moves outward. Their radial distances have a constant product.
readingZh: 青色圆保持不变，圆心就是原点。绿色点 \(P\) 一边绕圆心移动，一边改变到圆心的距离；金色像点 \(P'\) 始终与它处于同一射线。一点靠近圆心时，另一点就向外移动，两段距离的乘积保持不变。

zh: Euler 法的误差怎样累积
descriptionEn: Euler's method advances using the slope at the start of each step. For a smooth ODE with a suitable Lipschitz bound, one step started from the exact value has error \(O(h^2)\), while the accumulated error over fixed time is \(O(h)\). Halving a sufficiently small step therefore approximately halves global error; it does not quarter it.
descriptionZh: Euler 法用每一步起点处的斜率向前推进。对于足够光滑、满足适当 Lipschitz 条件的微分方程，从准确值出发走一步的误差是 \(O(h^2)\)，固定时间内累积的误差则是 \(O(h)\)。因此，步长足够小时，将它减半会使全局误差约减半，而不是缩小为四分之一。
readingEn: For \(y'=-y\), \(y(0)=1\), gold shows the exact exponential decay. Green shows Euler values joined by straight segments, using 4, 8, 16 and 32 steps up to \(T=3\). The cyan separation compares both curves at the moving time; \(E_3\) is the endpoint error.
readingZh: 对 \(y'=-y\)、\(y(0)=1\)，金色曲线是准确的指数衰减。绿色依次用 4、8、16 和 32 步走到 \(T=3\)，离散计算值之间以直线相连。移动的青色线段比较同一时刻两条曲线的差距；\(E_3\) 表示终点误差。

source.zh: Driscoll 与 Braun 数值计算教材 · Euler 法

zh: 用内外接多边形夹住圆周率
descriptionEn: For a unit circle, an inscribed regular \(n\)-gon has perimeter \(2n\sin(\pi/n)\), while the circumscribed one has perimeter \(2n\tan(\pi/n)\). The circumference lies between them. Dividing by the diameter gives lower and upper bounds for \(\pi\).
descriptionZh: 单位圆的内接正 \(n\) 边形周长为 \(2n\sin(\pi/n)\)，外切正 \(n\) 边形周长为 \(2n\tan(\pi/n)\)。圆周长介于两者之间，再除以直径，就得到 \(\pi\) 的下界和上界。
readingEn: The green polygon lies inside the cyan circle and the gold polygon surrounds it. Each cycle doubles the side count from six to ninety-six, narrowing the gap. The cyan point traces the circle; the printed bounds are rounded approximations.
readingZh: 绿色多边形内接于青色圆，金色多边形外切于圆。每轮从六边形开始，将边数逐次加倍到九十六边形，内外两侧的间隙不断缩小。青色光点沿圆周移动，右侧显示四舍五入后的上下界。

zh: 阻尼怎样消耗振动的能量
descriptionEn: Multiplying \(m\ddot x+b\dot x+kx=0\) by velocity gives this energy balance. Positive viscous damping removes mechanical energy at a rate proportional to squared speed. Underdamped displacement has an exponential amplitude envelope, but instantaneous energy is not an exact exponential: its rate of loss reaches zero at each turning point.
descriptionZh: 把 \(m\ddot x+b\dot x+kx=0\) 乘以速度，就得到这个能量关系。正的黏性阻尼持续消耗机械能，损失速率与速度平方成正比。欠阻尼位移具有指数衰减的振幅包络，但瞬时能量并非严格的指数曲线：每次运动到转折点，能量损失速率都暂时降为零。
readingEn: Green traces displacement within the gold amplitude bounds; cyan shows exact mechanical energy divided by its initial value. The parameters are \(m=1\), \(b=0.32\), \(k=2.89\), with \(x(0)=1\) and \(\dot x(0)=0\). The two moving points share time, so flattened portions of the energy curve can be compared with displacement extrema.
readingZh: 绿色位移曲线位于金色振幅包络内，青色曲线表示准确机械能与初始能量之比。参数为 \(m=1\)、\(b=0.32\)、\(k=2.89\)，初始条件为 \(x(0)=1\)、\(\dot x(0)=0\)。两个移动点对应同一时刻，可对照能量曲线变平的位置与位移的极值。

source.zh: OpenStax 大学物理 · 阻尼振动

descriptionEn: A point inside a triangle can be expressed as a weighted average of its vertices. The nonnegative weights sum to one. Each weight equals the area of the subtriangle opposite that vertex divided by the whole triangle’s area, linking interpolation to geometry.
descriptionZh: 三角形内部的点可以写成三个顶点的加权平均，三个权重非负且总和为一。每个权重，恰好等于该顶点对面的子三角形面积占总面积的比例，因此也能用面积来理解插值。
readingEn: The white point moves inside the fixed triangle. Green, gold and cyan subtriangles lie opposite vertices \(A,B,C\), respectively. Their changing area fractions are the three weights printed below. The sum stays one even though the displayed rounded values may not sum exactly.
readingZh: 白点在固定三角形内部移动。绿色、金色和青色子三角形分别位于顶点 \(A,B,C\) 的对面，下方显示各自的面积占比，也就是三个权重。实际权重之和始终为一，显示值因四舍五入可能略有差异。

zh: 方差来自组内还是组间
descriptionEn: For a variable with finite second moment, total variance splits into the average variance within groups and the variance of group means. Both terms use group probabilities as weights. The decomposition separates how dispersed observations are inside each group from how far the groups' centers lie apart.
descriptionZh: 对于二阶矩有限的随机变量，总方差可以分成两项：各组内部方差的平均，以及各组均值的方差。两项都按各组的概率加权。这样就能区分，总体差异有多少来自同一组内的分散，又有多少来自不同组中心的距离。
readingEn: Each row contains five equally weighted values with fixed offsets around its gold mean. As the means move to \(-d\) and \(d\), within-group variance \(W=0.245\) stays fixed while between-group variance \(B=d^2\) changes. The lower strip adds the two. These are population variances of the ten displayed values, not unbiased sample estimates.
readingZh: 每行有五个等权数值，与本组金色均值标记的偏移保持不变。两组均值移动到 \(-d\) 与 \(d\) 时，组内方差 \(W=0.245\) 不变，组间方差 \(B=d^2\) 随之变化，下方长条将两项相加。这里计算的是图中十个数值的总体方差，不是无偏样本方差估计。

source.zh: Pishro-Nik 概率教材 · 全方差公式

en: A right angle on a semicircle
descriptionEn: Fix a diameter \(AB\) and move \(P\) along either semicircle, away from its endpoints. The two sides \(PA\) and \(PB\) remain perpendicular: an inscribed angle subtends half the central angle, and the diameter spans 180 degrees.
descriptionZh: 固定直径 \(AB\)，让 \(P\) 沿半圆移动，但不与端点重合。\(PA\) 与 \(PB\) 始终垂直：同弧所对的圆周角是圆心角的一半，而直径对应的圆心角为 180 度。
readingEn: The cyan segment is the fixed diameter. \(P\) moves along the arc; the green triangle changes shape while the gold square marks the same right angle at \(P\).
readingZh: 青色线段是固定的直径。\(P\) 沿圆弧往复移动，绿色三角形的形状随之改变，\(P\) 处的金色方角始终标示直角。

descriptionEn: For a continuous function, moving the upper limit of its integral changes accumulated signed area at the rate given by the function’s current value. The fundamental theorem of calculus therefore recovers the integrand by differentiating the accumulation function.
descriptionZh: 连续函数的有向面积随积分上限移动而变化，其瞬时变化率就是该位置的函数值。微积分基本定理把这两个量联系起来：对有向面积的累积函数求导，就得到原来的被积函数。
readingEn: Left: green shading accumulates under the positive green curve up to the moving gold point. Right: the cyan curve plots that accumulated area, and its gold tangent has slope equal to the gold height on the left. Both panels follow the same upper limit, shown as \(x\).
readingZh: 左图函数值为正，绿色区域累积到移动的金点为止。右图的青线记录这块面积，金色切线的斜率等于左图金点所在的函数高度。两图使用同一个积分上限，底部的 \(x\) 标出当前位置。

descriptionEn: For independent Bernoulli trials with success probability \(p\), the sample proportion approaches \(p\) in probability. Its variance is \(p(1-p)/n\), and the probability of any fixed positive error tends to zero as \(n\) tends to infinity. Neither a finite-sample tail probability nor an individual path must improve at every step.
descriptionZh: 独立重复进行成功概率为 \(p\) 的伯努利试验，样本中的成功比例会依概率趋近 \(p\)。其方差为 \(p(1-p)/n\)；当 \(n\) 趋于无穷时，偏离任意固定正幅度的概率趋于零。有限样本的尾部概率和单条路径，都不必逐步改善。
readingEn: Three seeded simulations reveal the running proportions through 256 trials; the gold line is \(p=0.5\). The same finite paths replay as an illustration, not a proof. This concerns concentration of the average; the central limit theorem instead describes its scaled fluctuations.
readingZh: 三条固定种子的模拟路径逐步显示前 256 次试验的成功比例，金线表示 \(p=0.5\)。动画重复的是同一组有限样本，只作示意，不构成证明。这里关注平均值的集中；中心极限定理关注经过缩放后的波动形状。

descriptionEn: An internal angle bisector \(AD\) divides the opposite side \(BC\) in the ratio \(AB:AC\). Triangles \(ABD\) and \(ACD\) share the altitude to \(BC\); their areas are also proportional to \(AB\) and \(AC\) because their angles at \(A\) are equal.
descriptionZh: 内角平分线 \(AD\) 把对边 \(BC\) 分成两段，两段之比等于 \(AB\) 与 \(AC\) 之比。三角形 \(ABD\)、\(ACD\) 对 \(BC\) 的高相同；它们在 \(A\) 处的角相等，面积也就分别正比于 \(AB\)、\(AC\)。
readingEn: \(A\) moves while \(B\) and \(C\) stay fixed. The gold segment keeps the two marked angles equal. Matching colors connect each adjacent side to its corresponding base segment; the two ratios on the right remain equal.
readingZh: \(A\) 移动，\(B\)、\(C\) 保持不动，金线始终把顶角分成相等的两份。同色的邻边与底边线段互相对应，右侧显示的两个比值始终相等。

zh: 梯形误差为什么缩小到四分之一
descriptionEn: Replacing a convex curve by straight chords overestimates its integral. For \(x^2\) on \([0,1]\), the composite trapezoid error is exactly \(h^2/6\), where \(h=1/n\). Doubling the subdivision count therefore quarters the total error, rather than merely halving it.
descriptionZh: 用直线弦段代替凸函数的曲线，会高估积分。对区间 \([0,1]\) 上的平方函数，复合梯形公式的总误差恰好是步长平方的六分之一。分段数加倍、步长减半时，总误差缩小到原来的四分之一。
readingEn: Gold chords sit above the green parabola; the shaded slivers add up to the displayed error \(E\). A moving vertical segment inspects the local gap. The loop compares 2, 4, 8 and 16 equal subdivisions against the same exact integral, \(I=1/3\).
readingZh: 金色弦段位于绿色抛物线上方，夹出的阴影合起来就是底部显示的总误差 \(E\)。移动的竖线逐点检查两者的间隙。动画依次比较 2、4、8、16 等分，始终以精确积分 \(I=1/3\) 为参照。

source.zh: Driscoll 与 Braun · 数值积分

en: A bound without a bell curve
descriptionEn: If a distribution has finite mean \(\mu\) and positive finite variance \(\sigma^2\), at most \(1/k^2\) of its probability can lie at least \(k\) standard deviations from the mean. This uses only variance, so the bound can be much larger than the actual tail.
descriptionZh: 只要分布具有有限均值 \(\mu\) 和正的有限方差 \(\sigma^2\)，偏离均值至少 \(k\) 个标准差的概率就不会超过 \(1/k^2\)。这个结论只使用方差信息，因此上界可能比实际尾部概率宽松得多。
readingEn: The rectangle is the density of \(U[-\sqrt3,\sqrt3]\), with mean zero and variance one. Moving gold boundaries mark \(\pm k\); green area is the exact tail. The lower bars compare the bound with that tail on the same probability scale. Beyond \(\sqrt3\), the tail is zero while the bound remains positive.
readingZh: 矩形表示 \(U[-\sqrt3,\sqrt3]\) 的密度，其均值为零、方差为一。移动的金线标出 \(\pm k\)，绿色面积是实际尾部概率。下方两条横线用同一概率尺度比较上界与真实值；超过 \(\sqrt3\) 后，尾部已经为零，上界仍为正。

descriptionEn: Two chords intersect at \(P\) inside a circle with center \(O\) and radius \(R\). The products of the two segment lengths agree, regardless of chord direction, and equal \(R\) squared minus \(OP\) squared. The shared value changes only when \(P\) changes its distance from \(O\).
descriptionZh: 两条弦在半径为 \(R\)、圆心为 \(O\) 的圆内相交于 \(P\)。无论弦朝向哪里，两段长度的乘积都等于 \(R\) 的平方减去 \(OP\) 的平方。只有 \(P\) 到圆心的距离改变，这个共同值才会改变。
readingEn: The green and gold chords turn through a moving cyan point \(P\). Individual segments lengthen and shorten; the two products displayed on the right track the same value throughout.
readingZh: 绿弦与金弦穿过移动的青色交点 \(P\)，同时转动。各段长度不断改变，右侧两个乘积却始终同步。

en: Simpson’s rule is exact for cubics
zh: 辛普森公式为何能精确积分三次函数
descriptionEn: A quadratic through an interval’s endpoints and midpoint need not equal the original cubic. Yet their signed area difference cancels across the midpoint. Integrating that quadratic yields Simpson’s \(1:4:1\) weights, exact for every polynomial of degree at most three.
descriptionZh: 通过区间两端和中点的二次插值曲线，并不等于原来的三次曲线，但两者在中点左右的有向面积差会抵消。将这条二次曲线积分，得到辛普森公式的 \(1:4:1\) 权重；它能精确积分所有次数不超过三次的多项式。
readingEn: Green is \(x^3\); gold is its quadratic interpolant \(q_2(x)=1.5x^2-0.5x\) at \(0,1/2,1\). The moving segment checks their pointwise difference. The two shaded regions have opposite signs and equal area, so both integrals are \(1/4\) despite the different curves.
readingZh: 绿线是三次函数，金线是它在 \(0,1/2,1\) 三点的二次插值曲线，满足 \(q_2(x)=1.5x^2-0.5x\)。移动线段比较逐点差异。两侧阴影的有向面积大小相等、符号相反，因此两条曲线不同，积分却都等于 \(1/4\)。

descriptionEn: Once event \(B\) is known to have occurred, only outcomes in \(B\) remain possible. The part also belonging to \(A\) is \(A\cap B\); dividing its probability by \(\Pr(B)>0\) makes the reduced sample space have probability one.
descriptionZh: 已知事件 \(B\) 发生后，只考虑 \(B\) 内的结果。其中也属于 \(A\) 的部分就是交集 \(A\cap B\)。将交集概率除以 \(\Pr(B)>0\)，相当于把缩小后的样本空间重新归一化为一。
readingEn: Choose \(U\) uniformly from \([0,1]\). Cyan marks \(A=\{U\le0.6\}\), the gold frame marks \(B=\{U\ge b\}\), and green is their overlap. As \(b\) moves, the lower bar shows overlap divided by the width of \(B\), not by the original unit interval.
readingZh: 在 \([0,1]\) 内均匀抽取 \(U\)。青色表示 \(A=\{U\le0.6\}\)，金框表示 \(B=\{U\ge b\}\)，绿色是两者交集。随着 \(b\) 移动，下方横线显示交集宽度除以 \(B\) 的宽度，而不是除以原来的单位区间。

source.zh: Alexander Bogomolny · 维维亚尼定理

descriptionEn: For a point inside an equilateral triangle, the three perpendicular distances to the sides sum to its altitude \(h\). Join the point to the vertices: the three smaller triangle areas add to the original area, and all three bases have the same length.
descriptionZh: 等边三角形内一点到三边的垂直距离之和，等于三角形的高 \(h\)。连接该点与三个顶点，得到的三个小三角形面积之和不变；它们的底边等长，因此三条高的和也不变。
readingEn: Three colored perpendiculars follow the interior point. On the right, their lengths are stacked at the same scale as the triangle and compared with the fixed altitude \(h\); the top of the stack stays level.
readingZh: 内部光点移动时，三条彩色垂线随之变化。右侧按与三角形相同的比例，把三段距离首尾叠放，再与固定的高 \(h\) 比较；叠放后的顶端始终不动。

en: Finding a root with two points
descriptionEn: The secant method replaces the derivative in Newton’s step with the slope through the two most recent function values. Its intersection with the horizontal axis supplies the next estimate. No derivative is required, but a nearly zero difference between the two function values can make the step unreliable.
descriptionZh: 割线法取最近两个点，用它们之间的斜率代替牛顿法中的导数，再把割线与横轴的交点作为下一次估计。它不需要计算导数，但若两次函数值几乎相等，分母过小就可能使迭代步失控。
readingEn: Starting at 1 and 2 to find the zero \(\sqrt{2}\) of \(f(x)=x^2-2\), each stage draws the gold secant and its cyan root estimate \(x_+\). The moving cyan dot follows the straight-line prediction. The view zooms between iterations; \(W\) gives its horizontal width, so visually similar steps need not have equal numerical size.
readingZh: 以 1 和 2 为初值，求 \(f(x)=x^2-2\) 的零点 \(\sqrt{2}\)。每一轮画出金色割线及青色零点估计 \(x_+\)，移动青点沿割线检查线性预测。各轮会放大观察范围；\(W\) 表示当前视窗的横坐标跨度，因此画面上大小相近的步长，实际数值可能相差很大。

source.zh: Driscoll 与 Braun · 割线法
Pishro-Nik · 协方差与相关系数

descriptionEn: Covariance measures the average product of centered deviations and carries the units of both variables. Dividing by their positive standard deviations gives dimensionless correlation. Positive rescaling changes covariance but preserves correlation; zero correlation alone does not imply independence.
descriptionZh: 协方差是两个变量相对各自均值的偏差之积的平均，带有两者的单位。除以各自正的标准差，就得到无量纲的相关系数。正比例缩放会改变协方差，却不改变相关系数；相关系数为零也不一定意味着独立。
readingEn: The left cloud stretches horizontally as \(a\) changes. The right cloud subtracts each mean and divides by its standard deviation, so it keeps the same shape and \(\rho=0.65\). These equally weighted constructed points illustrate normalization; the moving gold markers connect corresponding positions.
readingZh: 左侧点集随 \(a\) 改变而横向伸缩；右侧减去各自均值、再除以标准差，形状和 \(\rho=0.65\) 因而保持不变。这里使用等权重的构造点集演示标准化，移动金点标出两边的对应位置。

descriptionEn: In a non-equilateral triangle, circumcenter \(O\), centroid \(G\) and orthocenter \(H\) lie on the Euler line. \(G\) divides \(OH\) in the ratio \(1:2\). For an equilateral triangle the three centers coincide, so they no longer determine a unique line.
descriptionZh: 非等边三角形的外心 \(O\)、重心 \(G\)、垂心 \(H\) 位于同一条欧拉线上，\(G\) 把 \(OH\) 分成 \(1:2\)。等边三角形的三心重合，因而不能由它们确定唯一的直线。
readingEn: One vertex moves around the circle. \(O\) remains its center; the faint medians meet at \(G\), and \(H\) is the intersection of the altitudes. The gold segment joins the three centers. The enlarged ruler on the right shows their fixed division ratio.
readingZh: 一个顶点沿圆周移动。\(O\) 始终是圆心，浅色中线交于 \(G\)，\(H\) 是三条高的交点。金线连起三心，右侧放大的比例尺显示它们不变的分段比例。

en: One polynomial through all the nodes
zh: 穿过所有节点的唯一多项式
descriptionEn: For \(n+1\) distinct horizontal coordinates, exactly one polynomial of degree at most \(n\) passes through the given values. Lagrange basis polynomials construct it: each basis is one at its own node and zero at every other node. Uniqueness does not by itself guarantee accurate values between nodes.
descriptionZh: 给定 \(n+1\) 个横坐标互不相同的节点，恰有一条次数不超过 \(n\) 的多项式曲线穿过全部指定值。拉格朗日基函数给出构造方法：每个基函数在自己的节点等于一，在其他节点等于零。不过，插值唯一并不等于节点之间的估计一定准确。
readingEn: The two cyan endpoints stay fixed while the gold middle value moves. At every instant the green quadratic passes through all three points. Moving one value alters the curve across the interval, even though its other two prescribed values remain fixed.
readingZh: 两个青色端点固定，金色中点的纵坐标持续变化。每一时刻，绿色二次曲线都经过全部三个节点。只改变一个指定值，也会影响整个区间内的曲线；另外两个节点的指定值则始终保持不变。

source.zh: Driscoll 与 Braun · 多项式插值
杨百翰大学 ACME · 高斯混合模型

descriptionEn: A mixture first chooses a component with probability \(w\), then draws from that component. Its density is the weighted sum of component densities, with total area one. Two Gaussian components can produce one peak or two; averaging their means does not recover this shape. Here \(\phi_\sigma\) denotes the centered Gaussian density with standard deviation \(\sigma\).
descriptionZh: 混合分布先按概率 \(w\) 选择一个成分，再从该成分中抽样。总密度是各成分密度的加权和，曲线下面积仍为一。两个高斯成分可以形成单峰，也可以形成双峰；仅对均值求平均，无法保留这种形状。 这里的 \(\phi_\sigma\) 表示均值为零、标准差为 \(\sigma\) 的高斯密度。
readingEn: Cyan and gold are the two weighted densities, each with area \(1/2\); green is their pointwise sum. Their means move from \(\pm0.2\) to \(\pm1.75\), while \(\sigma=0.65\) stays fixed. Separation changes the number of peaks. The finite window omits small Gaussian tails outside the frame.
readingZh: 青线和金线分别是面积为 \(1/2\) 的加权密度，绿线是它们逐点相加的结果。均值从 \(\pm0.2\) 移至 \(\pm1.75\)，而 \(\sigma=0.65\) 不变，峰的数量随间距改变。画面只截取有限区间，框外仍有很小的高斯尾部。

en: A point and a line define a parabola
zh: 一个点和一条线定义抛物线
descriptionEn: A parabola contains the points equally far from a focus and a directrix. With the vertex as origin, focus \(F=(p,0)\), and directrix \(x=-p\), equating the distances and squaring gives \(y^2=4px\), for \(p>0\).
descriptionZh: 抛物线上的点到焦点和准线的距离相等。以顶点为原点，令焦点为 \(F=(p,0)\)、准线为 \(x=-p\)，且 \(p>0\)；把两段距离相等的式子平方并化简，就得到 \(y^2=4px\)。
readingEn: \(P\) moves along the cyan parabola. The green segment reaches the focus \(F\); the gold segment reaches the perpendicular foot \(D\) on the vertical directrix. Their length bars on the right always match.
readingZh: \(P\) 沿青色抛物线移动。绿线连向焦点 \(F\)，金线连向竖直准线上的垂足 \(D\)；右侧按长度画出的两条横线始终一样长。

en: Why interpolation nodes cluster at the ends
zh: 插值节点为何向两端聚集
descriptionEn: More equally spaced samples need not improve high-degree polynomial interpolation: Runge’s function develops large endpoint oscillations. Chebyshev nodes place more samples near both ends. For this analytic function, that redistribution controls the endpoint problem and produces convergent polynomial approximations.
descriptionZh: 高次多项式插值中，等距样本增加不一定让近似更准：龙格函数的插值曲线会在区间两端产生明显振荡。切比雪夫节点将更多样本布置在两端。对于图中这样的解析函数，这种重新分配能抑制端部问题，使插值逐步收敛。
readingEn: Green is the exact function. Gold uses equal nodes; cyan uses Chebyshev nodes, shown in matching rows below. Degrees 6, 8 and 10 share one unclipped scale. Moving markers compare both approximations with the true value, especially near the endpoints.
readingZh: 绿线是真实函数，金线使用等距节点，青线使用切比雪夫节点；底部两排同色圆点列出节点位置。6、8、10 次插值共用同一尺度，曲线没有裁剪。移动标记比较两种插值与真值的偏差，尤其留意区间两端。

source.en: Driscoll & Braun · Stability of polynomial interpolation
source.zh: Driscoll 与 Braun · 多项式插值的稳定性

descriptionEn: For \(n\) independent draws from \(U[0,1]\), the maximum is at most \(x\) only when every draw is at most \(x\). Independence multiplies those probabilities, giving \(x^n\). More draws push the maximum toward one, even though each individual draw stays uniform.
descriptionZh: 独立地从 \(U[0,1]\) 抽取 \(n\) 个数，只有每个数都不超过 \(x\)，最大值才不超过 \(x\)。独立性让这些概率相乘，得到 \(x^n\)。抽样次数越多，最大值越靠近一，但单次抽样仍然是均匀的。
readingEn: The curves show cumulative probabilities for \(n=1,2,4,8\), all on the same axes. Green highlights \(n=4\). At the moving threshold \(x\), the gold height gives the probability that all four draws stay to its left. These are exact distributions, not simulated frequencies.
readingZh: 四条曲线在相同坐标轴上给出 \(n=1,2,4,8\) 时的累积概率，绿色突出 \(n=4\)。阈值 \(x\) 移动时，金点高度表示四个样本都落在其左侧的概率。曲线来自精确分布，并非模拟频数。

en: A fixed difference makes a hyperbola
descriptionEn: For a hyperbola, the absolute difference between distances to two fixed foci is \(2a\). With \(a,b>0\), center at the origin and foci \((\pm c,0)\), the parameters satisfy \(c^2=a^2+b^2\). Fixing the difference produces two unbounded branches. Switching branches reverses the signed difference but preserves its magnitude.
descriptionZh: 双曲线上的点到两个固定焦点的距离之差，绝对值恒为 \(2a\)。取 \(a,b>0\)，以中心为原点，焦点为 \((\pm c,0)\)，参数满足 \(c^2=a^2+b^2\)。固定距离之差，会形成两条向外延伸的分支；换到另一支，差的符号改变，绝对值不变。
readingEn: \(P\) travels along the right branch. Green and gold segments join it to the foci; matching bars below show both lengths. The cyan remainder between the bar endpoints stays fixed even as both bars change.
readingZh: \(P\) 在右支上往复移动，绿色和金色线段分别连向两个焦点。下方同色横线表示这两段长度；两条横线都在伸缩，端点之间的青色差值却保持不变。

en: The circle that matches a curve’s bend
zh: 与曲线弯曲程度相同的圆
descriptionEn: An osculating circle shares a curve’s tangent and curvature at one point. Its center lies along the principal normal and its radius is the reciprocal of curvature. On a parabola, the circle changes size as the contact point moves: a larger radius means a gentler local bend.
descriptionZh: 密切圆在接触点与曲线具有相同的切线和曲率，圆心位于该点的主法线方向，半径等于曲率的倒数。沿抛物线移动时，密切圆随位置改变大小；半径越大，表示该处转弯越平缓。
readingEn: The green point moves along the parabola. The gold circle touches it with the same local bend; the cyan radius is perpendicular to the faint tangent. The radius and curvature shown below always have product one. This is local contact, not a circle fitting the whole parabola.
readingZh: 绿点沿抛物线移动，金色圆在该点与曲线相切，弯曲程度也相同；青色半径垂直于淡色切线。底部显示的半径与曲率之积始终为一。这个圆描述接触点附近的形状，并不拟合整条抛物线。

en: Turn uniform draws into a shape
zh: 把均匀抽样变成目标分布
descriptionEn: A continuous strictly increasing CDF turns a probability level into a quantile through its inverse. If \(U\) is uniform on \([0,1]\), then \(X=F^{-1}(U)\) has CDF \(F\). For \(F(x)=x^2\) on \([0,1]\), taking \(\sqrt U\) produces density \(2x\).
descriptionZh: 连续且严格递增的累积分布函数，可以通过反函数将概率水平映射为分位数。如果 \(U\) 在 \([0,1]\) 上均匀分布，那么 \(X=F^{-1}(U)\) 的累积分布就是 \(F\)。当 \([0,1]\) 上的 \(F(x)=x^2\) 时，对 \(U\) 开平方就得到密度 \(2x\)。
formula: X=\sqrt U,\ U\sim U[0,1],\qquad\Pr(X\le x)=x^2\quad(0\le x\le1)
readingEn: Start at probability \(u\) on the vertical axis, move horizontally to the green CDF, then down to \(x=\sqrt u\). Equally spaced probability guides land closer together near one, where density is higher. The gold guide sweeps through quantiles; its animation speed is not a random-sampling frequency.
readingZh: 从纵轴的概率 \(u\) 出发，水平移到绿色累积分布曲线，再向下读出 \(x=\sqrt u\)。等间距的概率线在接近一时落得更密，那里密度更高。金线依次扫过分位数，其动画速度不代表随机抽样的频率。

en: The sine rule measures a circle
descriptionEn: Divide each side of a triangle by the sine of its opposite angle: all three ratios equal its circumcircle's diameter \(2R\). Moving a vertex changes side lengths and angles together while the common ratio stays fixed if the circle does.
descriptionZh: 三角形的每条边除以对角的正弦，三个比值都等于外接圆的直径 \(2R\)。顶点移动时，边长与角度一同变化；只要外接圆不变，这个共同的比值就不变。
readingEn: \(A\) moves along the fixed circumcircle while \(B\) and \(C\) remain still. Each colored side lies opposite the angle of the same color. The three numerical ratios on the right all remain equal to \(2R\).
readingZh: \(A\) 沿固定的外接圆移动，\(B\)、\(C\) 保持不动。每条彩色边对应同色的对角，右侧三个数值比始终等于 \(2R\)。

en: Measuring a curve with shorter chords
zh: 用越来越短的弦测量曲线
descriptionEn: A straight chord is shorter than the curved segment joining the same endpoints. Refining nested partitions adds polygonal length, and for a continuously differentiable graph the limit is the integral of \(\sqrt{1+(f^{\prime})^2}\). The extra derivative term accounts for vertical travel as well as horizontal travel.
descriptionZh: 连接相同端点时，直线弦段比弯曲路径短。不断细分已有分段，折线总长度随之增加；对连续可微的函数曲线，其极限就是弧长积分。根号里的导数平方把竖直位移也计入路程，而不只计算横向距离。
readingEn: Green is \(y=x^2/2\), gold is the inscribed polygon, and cyan highlights the chord under the moving point. The partition doubles from 2 to 32 segments. Its total length \(L_n\) approaches the fixed exact length \(L\) from below; the same scale is used on both axes.
readingZh: 绿线是抛物线 \(y=x^2/2\)，金线是连接分点的内接折线，青色线段标出移动绿点所在的分段。分段数从 2 逐次加倍至 32，折线长度 \(L_n\) 从下方接近固定的精确弧长 \(L\)；横纵坐标保持相同尺度。

source.en: OpenStax · Arc length of a curve

source.zh: 卡内基梅隆大学 · KL 散度

descriptionEn: KL divergence averages the log probability ratio under the first distribution. It is nonnegative and zero when the distributions match, but exchanging their roles generally changes the result. Here \(p\) and \(q\) are Bernoulli success probabilities; natural logarithms give units of nats.
descriptionZh: KL 散度按第一个分布，对两者概率之比的对数取平均。它非负，两分布相同时为零，但交换两者通常会得到不同结果。这里的 \(p\) 和 \(q\) 是伯努利分布的成功概率，使用自然对数，单位为 nat。
readingEn: Keep \(p=0.30\) fixed and move \(q\). Green is \(D(p\Vert q)\), cyan is \(D(q\Vert p)\); both meet zero at \(q=p\). Their different heights show why KL is not a symmetric distance. Only \(0.04\le q\le0.96\) is plotted, avoiding infinite divergences at unsupported outcomes.
readingZh: 固定 \(p=0.30\)，改变 \(q\)。绿色表示 \(D(p\Vert q)\)，青色表示 \(D(q\Vert p)\)，两者都在 \(q=p\) 时降至零。不同的高度说明 KL 不是对称距离。图中只画 \(0.04\le q\le0.96\)，避开对某个可能结果赋零概率而产生的无穷散度。
